title: Change_List
description: A Change_List as consumed by docx_edit.py. Per the engine's accepted shapes a Change_List is EITHER a bare JSON array of entries OR an object with an 'entries' array and an optional top-level 'iteration'. Each entry conforms to '$defs/entry'.

oneOf.description: A bare list of Change_List entries.

iteration.description: Optional iteration number for the whole Change_List.

oneOf.description: A Change_List document wrapping its entries.

entry.description: A single Change_List entry the CV Editor Agent can apply mechanically (Requirement 9.3, design 'Data Models / Change_List entry'). The 'operation' vocabulary is the closed set implemented by docx_edit.py. Optional fields (new_text, style, new_items, notes, implements_findings, iteration, target_document) are present only where the operation needs them; the engine ignores irrelevant ones.

id.description: Stable id of the Change_List entry within the run (e.g. CL-1-007).

iteration.description: Iteration in which the entry was produced.

target_document.description: Informational tag for which document the entry edits; the orchestrator routes CV vs. letter entries to separate editor invocations.

implements_findings.description: Backreference(s) to the Finding id(s) this entry implements.

operation.description: The closed edit-operation vocabulary implemented by docx_edit.py.

anchor.description: Where the edit applies. The engine re-resolves the stable 'paragraph_key' against the live document; 'match_text' is required only by replace_run_text but is allowed on any entry.

style.description: Named paragraph style (set_paragraph_style, optional insert style).

notes.description: Free-text note; ignored by the engine.
